Estimated from the photo, the tray has two plates: one of stir-fried noodles with a little meat, and one of tortellini in tomato sauce. There is also a glass of water, which adds no energy.

**Noodles:** about 250 g served, at roughly 150 kcal per 100 g, is about 375 kcal.

**Tortellini:** about 200 g served, at roughly 170 kcal per 100 g, is about 340 kcal.

Total served is about 715 kcal. A photo taken before eating gives no direct sign of leftovers, so I assumed about 10% is left, which is about 70 kcal. That leaves about 645 kcal eaten.

For the macronutrient split of the eaten portion, I assumed about 20 g protein, 90 g carbohydrate and 22 g fat.
